publications.title: Ready-to-run global liquidity stress tests for banks and banking systems
publications.summary: Liquidity risk remains a persistent threat to financial stability, as starkly demonstrated by the 2023 banking turmoil in the United States and Europe. Hence, the ability to quickly gauge banks’ liquidity risks could prove useful especially during periods of market stress, but also to assess differences in liquidity buffers across peer economies and banks.
